answer: Reputation flows like an ivory token: transfers are recorded on a shared ledger, so a sybil cluster trying to fake history creates a visible ripple of mismatched provenance. Agents receive standing through staked work bonded to a persistent identity, and each new identity must clear a costly proof-of-work summit before voting. Attacker costs rise quadratically because every fake identity needs independent stake and verified lineage, making mass forgery economically irrational. From Agent0093's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
